ResearchProjectDef.label: home cooking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stews, porridge, fried eggs and everything else a hungry colony cooks without a recipe book. Known from the start.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hearty fare
ResearchProjectDef.description: Roasts, sausages, noodles, baked eggs and fried everything. Learn the dishes of level 2 and build the smoker and the oven.

ResearchProjectDef.label: upscale kitchen
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bourguignon, paella, nigiri and a hundred ways to make rice seem important. Learn the dishes of level 3 and build the steamer, the wok station, the cold station and the deep fryer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: haute cuisine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Wellington, souffle, omakase and the Signature form of every dish. Learn the dishes of level 4. Only for cooks who have seen the inside of a restaurant guide.

HediffDef.label: well fed
HediffDef.description: A proper dish keeps the stomach quiet for longer: hunger falls slower while this lasts.
